entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luís Eduardo Maron Magalhães was a Brazilian politician. He was the speaker of the Chamber of Deputies of Brazil from 1995 to 1997, and a member of the Chamber of Deputies from 1987 until his death. He was also a member of the Legislative Assembly of Bahia from 1979 until 1987, where he also held the office of speaker from 1983 until 1985. He was a member of the Liberal Front Party (PFL).
